name: adsb.lol
description: Free, open ADS-B aircraft tracking API for live positions by aircraft hex, callsign, registration, type, squawk, or geographic radius. Data is ODbL licensed; production users should contact adsb.lol because the public API has no SLA and may require feeder authentication in the future.

tools.name: get_aircraft_by_hex
tools.description: Get live ADS-B state for one or more ICAO 24-bit transponder hex identifiers. Separate multiple identifiers with commas.

icao_hex.description: ICAO transponder hex, or comma-separated hex identifiers.

tools.name: get_aircraft_by_callsign
tools.description: Get live aircraft matching an exact flight callsign such as JBU1942. Callsigns can differ from passenger-facing flight numbers.

tools.name: get_aircraft_by_registration
tools.description: Get live aircraft matching an exact registration/tail number.

tools.name: get_aircraft_by_type
tools.description: Get live aircraft matching an ICAO aircraft type code such as A320 or B738.

tools.name: get_aircraft_by_squawk
tools.description: Get live aircraft broadcasting a transponder squawk such as 7700.

tools.name: aircraft_near_point
tools.description: List live aircraft within a radius of a latitude/longitude point. Radius is nautical miles and cannot exceed 250.

tools.name: closest_aircraft
tools.description: Return the single live aircraft closest to a point within the supplied maximum radius.

tools.name: list_military_aircraft
tools.description: List live aircraft tagged as military.

tools.name: list_ladd_aircraft
tools.description: List live aircraft tagged under Limiting Aircraft Data Displayed (LADD).

tools.name: list_pia_aircraft
tools.description: List live aircraft using Privacy ICAO Address (PIA) identifiers.

tools.name: get_airport
tools.description: Get airport metadata by ICAO airport identifier.

icao.description: Four-letter ICAO airport code, such as EDDF.

tools.name: resolve_routes
tools.description: Resolve route metadata for multiple aircraft using callsign and current position.

planes.description: Aircraft callsigns and current coordinates to resolve.
